title: Comparisons & Jumps [Code]
description:
## Time to jump
You know what `cmp` and conditional jumps do. Now use them.

Remember the pattern:
```asm
    cmp rax, value
    jg label        ; jump if rax > value
    ; code if not greater
    jmp done
label:
    ; code if greater
done:
```


---
## Assignment:
LHINX needs a memory check at boot. The value in `rax` is the available memory. If `rax` is greater than or equal to 1024, print `Boot OK`. Otherwise print `Low memory`. The memory value is already set for you.
starterCode:
section .data
    ok_msg db "Boot OK", 10
    ok_len equ $ - ok_msg
    low_msg db "Low memory", 10
    low_len equ $ - low_msg

section .text
    global _start

_start:
    mov rax, 2048
    ; compare rax to 1024 and jump

    ; exit
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
